content:
Chapter 648 - 648 System; Protagonist? (2)

Chapter 648 - 648 System; Protagonist? (2)

648 System; Protagonist? (2)

“Let’s cut the crap and set off!”

“Yes, Teacher!” all the students said in unison.

Then, the students walked inside together.

Qin Chuan and the black-robed man quietly watched them leave.

After everyone had entered, the man in black said, “Do you think someone will enter E-class this time?”

“Of course!” Qin Chuan replied.

“Oh?” The man in black was surprised. “How many?”

Qin Chuan smiled. “I just said that because it’d be too boring otherwise. Why don’t we bet on something?”

“You’ve already lost 10,000 World Coins to me, but you haven’t given the money to me yet,” the man in black said.

“It’s only 10,000 World Coins. We’ll bet 20,000 World Coins this time. As long as I win, you only need to give me 10,000 World Coins.”

The black-clothed man’s mouth twitched slightly. He said, “You said the same thing when you owed me 5,000 World Coins.”

“Did I?” Qin Chuan smiled. “There’s no need to care about these details. Then let’s make a deal. This time, I’ll bet 20,000 World Coins on five or more entering E-class!”

“Five?” The man in black was a little surprised.

One had to know…

According to past experience, only one or two students would enter E-class when they entered the forbidden area.

Five were definitely rare.

“How about it? Do you dare to bet?” Qin Chuan asked.

“Since you want to give me money, why would I refuse?” The man in black laughed.

…

The forest was like a huge ice cellar.

As soon as he walked in, the heat from before disappeared instantly, and the temperature seemed to have dropped by more than ten degrees.

When a gentle breeze blew, some people could not help but shiver.

All the students looked around curiously, and from time to time, they would let out a discussion.

Xia Xue, who was walking farther back, slowly took out the folding screen and opened the live broadcast platform.

It had to be said that Xia Xue had become very popular.

Not long after the broadcast started, the number of viewers reached more than 100,000.

Many comments kept appearing.

Promise of the Gods: [Xia Xue has started her live broadcast again!]

Everyone: [Where is this place? A forest? Is Xia Xue traveling?]

Idiot: [So many people.]

Waiting for TA in My Heart: [Wow! I saw Lin Fan! So handsome!]

…

Xia Xue whispered, “Hello everyone. I’m very happy to meet you again.

“Today, the sophomore year at Jiangbei University will be exploring the forbidden area for a week. Right now, everyone in our class is in Forbidden Area No. 31.”

…

In the live broadcast room.

Tired: [Forbidden area! The legendary forbidden area!]

Beggar: [Jiangbei University is awesome! Students can enter the forbidden area.]

The Weather is Really Cold: [My biggest dream is to go to a forbidden area!]

Carefree Dream: [Sure enough, the resources of a good university are excellent!]

Repairman: [From today onward, be a person who loves to learn. Read books, do homework, and recite texts!]

Mysterious Flower: [What did Xia Xue just say? Everyone in her class? So, Lin Fan and Xia Xue are classmates?]

Grace: [Did Lin Fan change classes to be Xia Xue’s classmate in order to chase after her? Heavens! It’s as if I’m looking at a 200,000-word romance novel!]

…

When Xia Xue read the comments, she was stunned for a moment.

Lin Fan had specially transferred classes to be her classmate?

Was that so?

Otherwise, why would he come to her class?

Otherwise, why would he be her deskmate?

Also, he had sat beside her on the bus just now.

Was he really pursuing her?

Thinking of this, Xia Xue’s entire face instantly turned red.

She raised her head and looked at Lin Fan.

At this moment, Lin Fan looked over.

They looked at each other.

In an instant, Xia Xue’s face was red as a tomato, and she quickly turned her head to the side.

In the blink of an eye, two hours had passed.

At first, everyone felt that the forest was very cold.

However, at this moment, they were all drenched in sweat.

The path in the forest was too difficult to walk on.

In addition, everyone was carrying a big bag on their backs, which was very exhausting.

A short and thin man accidentally tripped on a rock and fell to the ground.

The round-faced man beside him was quick to react. He hurriedly supported him so that he did not fall.

Even so, the short and thin man was so scared that he broke out in a cold sweat.

“Thank you, Li Dongqiang,” he hurriedly said to the round-faced man.

As soon as he said this, a crisp notification sounded in Li Dongqiang’s mind.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a gratitude token. It can be used for the lucky draw.]

Lucky draw!

[Ding! Congratulations, your strength has increased by five pounds’ worth.]

Suddenly, Li Dongqiang felt his entire body become much lighter.

An increase in strength!

Li Dongqiang thought excitedly, ‘Is this the legendary system? Helping someone can earn you gratitude tokens and then power? I’m simply the protagonist of the legends! If this continues, how strong will I become?’

He was so happy that his eyes turned into slits. He waved his hands and said, “You’re welcome. It’s just a small matter.”

But soon, Li Dongqiang said, “Actually, it doesn’t matter if you thank me more.”

The short and thin man was slightly stunned.

‘Thank you more?

‘What the hell?’

He looked at Li Dongqiang’s serious expression and could not help but say again, “Thank… Thank you.”

However, this time, there was no notification in Li Dongqiang’s mind.

This made Li Dongqiang somewhat puzzled.

…

Lin Fan, who was not too far away, saw everything.

Li Dongqiang thought that no one could hear the system voice in his head and no one knew what he was thinking.

Actually, all of this could not escape Lin Fan’s ears.

Lin Fan’s face was filled with curiosity.

System?

This person called Li Dongqiang also had a system?

Were there many systems after a thousand years?

Gratitude tokens, they seemed quite interesting.

…

After Li Dongqiang received a gratitude token from the short and thin man, it was as if he had found the password to become stronger. Along the way, he carefully observed the figures of his classmates. If anyone accidentally tripped, he would immediately go forward to help them.

However, after half an hour, no one tripped again.

This made Li Dongqiang a little disappointed.

At this moment, a man named Zhang Fen, who was walking closer to the front and wearing silver-rimmed glasses, said, “It’s almost time. I suggest that everyone eat lunch here and then take a break. What do you think?”

Zhang Fen was the class monitor.

He had a certain amount of prestige in the class.

In addition, the students were indeed hungry.

Hence, they all agreed.

“Alright.”

“Yes, we’ll rest here.”

“Let’s eat something.”

…

In today’s life, the vast majority of things could be handed over to the androids.

Androids could cook delicious food and clean the house very well.

Gradually, many people got used to a clean and tidy environment.

In fact, they even had mysophobia.

In the past, as long as there was something dirty on the chair, some students might not sit on it.

However, at this moment, they were sitting on branches and rocks that were covered in dirt.

Sometimes, it was not that people could not accept it, it was just that they were pretentious.

Along the way, Lin Fan always followed Xia Xue.

Now that they were resting, it was the same.

He reached into his backpack as if he was taking something out of it.

With a thought, he placed the things in his inner space into his hand.

Following that, Lin Fan brought out the delicacies one by one.

Lin Fan said, “Xia Xue, you must be hungry too. Come and eat.”

When they were eating at the Imperial Hotel, Lin Fan had specially observed Xia Xue and knew what she liked to eat.

Sure enough, when Lin Fan took out the delicacies, Xia Xue could not move her eyes away.

She seemed to recall the deliciousness of the food and could not help but swallow her saliva.
